architecture.summary: Free signup and the portal follow the tenant of each organization (SO-07). Signup checks the free-tenant cap after its switch and before the notice, on the registry copy of the gateway lookup, and requests the tenant after the confirmed first Admin membership; with MCP_TENANTS_ENABLED on, signup therefore depends on the tenant registry. The new account route GET /workspace/status gives the portal the state of the tenant of the selected organization through the registry port of the gateway, with the tenant request for a missing row, and only with current product access in that organization. The portal shows the setup words with a meta refresh every 5 s and the connection guide only when the workspace is ready, so the portal/server account contract changes. Web reaches the registry only through ports that app composes: no component, import edge, external integration, or public module is added. The registry view of the tenant registry gains web as a caller, the collaboration overview names signup and the status, and a signup scenario is added.
